scripts.dev: npm run bundles && npm run build:main && electron .
scripts.build:linux: node build-bundles.mjs && node build-main.mjs && electron-builder --config electron-builder-linux.yml --publish never
scripts.build:mac: node build-bundles.mjs --platform mac-arm64 && node build-main.mjs && electron-builder --config electron-builder-mac.yml --publish never
scripts.build:win: node build-bundles.mjs --platform win-x64 && node build-main.mjs && electron-builder --config electron-builder-win.yml --publish never
